top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are a molecular design principle (a lipid neutral in blood and charged in the endosome, with controlled self-assembly to entrap and release polyanionic nucleic acids) whose consequences are already delivered at scale in siRNA therapy and mRNA vaccines. The 2023 Medicine prize honoured the cargo modification, not the vehicle, and a citation limited to entrapment and pH-triggered release with Cullis, Hope and Madden is narrow and defensible. If B016 fails, I prefer the two-part P001 (base editing plus C-N coupling) over either part alone, then Liu alone, then the mature but 2010-adjacent C-N coupling alone, and any award over none.
